title: Deleting a workspace can leave one of its files live and unreachable
reason: Reports a live shared file orphaned by a race between workspace-file cleanup and workspace-link deletion; the sole maintainer reply agrees to implement atomic cleanup after deciding whether orphaned files should be deleted or moved.
assessment: Varve has local-first documents and no hosted workspace/file ownership graph or share-link reachability state matching this database race. It is an upstream service invariant and policy decision, not a Varve storage defect.

title: Add underline to the rich text formatting options
reason: The three comments confirm underline already works through Cmd/Ctrl+U; the debate is whether tldraw.com should surface it in the toolbar, while SDK integrators can add it.
assessment: Varve already represents underline as rich-text formatting, exposes it in typography controls, handles its shortcut, and renders it through shared text layout/export paths; no implementation gap was found.

reason: The sole comment says tldraw.com already provides a Viewer sharing role, resolving the requested behavior in the upstream hosted product.
assessment: Varve does not provide hosted real-time sharing, user roles, or collaborative edit permissions. This is not a local capability parity gap in the current offline-first product.

title: Bookmarks and notes are mispositioned when resizing a group
reason: The report provides a concrete reproduce sequence and the sole comment confirms it still reproduces upstream; it concerns a child that keeps its size while the group is resized.
assessment: Varve has grouped transforms but no tldraw bookmark shape with the same keep-size-on-group-resize contract. The report is a useful parity lead for group transforms of fixed-size children; a matching Varve node and interaction must be checked before treating it as a local defect.

title: Nested frames clip child shapes at a 45 degree angle
reason: The issue describes clipping after moving/resizing a nested frame, and its sole comment points to a related upstream report without adding a Varve-specific reproduction artifact.
assessment: Varve supports nested frames with child clipping and computes each frame's transformed quadrilateral. No local reproduction has been established; this is retained as a visual regression lead for rotated/nested frame clipping rather than a confirmed defect.

title: Comment threads draw over the toolbar and style panel
reason: Reports hosted comment-thread canvas surfaces overlapping persistent editor chrome. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve has no collaborative comment pins, threads, or comment-placement overlays. Its local annotations and chrome use different overlay surfaces, so this tldraw comment-layer regression has no equivalent to fix.

title: Open menus swallow wheel events, so the canvas won't pan
reason: The report documents a concrete pointer-over-menu reproduction and names two event-occluding overlays. Varve menus are also portaled outside the canvas wheel listener; run a browser reproduction before deciding whether to add wheel pass-through.
assessment: Varve's canvas wheel handler is bound to the canvas element while public menus render through FloatingPortal. This structural similarity warrants an E2E check with an open menu; a portal alone does not establish the same interaction failure.

title: Deep link with a zero-size viewport parks the camera at the origin instead of falling back to page content
reason: The report concerns a parsed x/y/width/height viewport payload whose zero dimensions bypass validation. No comments were available.
assessment: Varve's navigation URL contract encodes target position and zoom, not a viewport rectangle with width and height; the reported zero-size payload has no matching route or parser state.

title: trigger-dotcom-hotfix.ts keeps [skip ci] in the cherry-picked commit, so dotcom-hotfix-please never merges or deploys release-notes PRs
reason: The sole comment reports the issue fixed by #10648, which strips skip markers from both the cherry-picked commit and the hotfix pull-request title.
assessment: The cited internal tldraw dotcom release workflow and hotfix branch are unrelated to Varve's release automation. No corresponding skip-marker bug was found in the local release flow.

title: Leaving an empty text shape still costs one undo press, which reverts nothing
reason: The sole comment disputes the reported selection-undo baseline, while the body provides a concrete sequence and claims the extra selection-only undo remains after the empty text is removed.
assessment: Varve removes an abandoned empty text node inside the still-open creation transaction, preventing an empty layer from becoming a persisted document snapshot. The separate selection-history behavior in the issue's move → empty text → undo sequence has not yet been exercised end to end, so it remains a parity check rather than a confirmed local bug.
